description: This Java class, 'AccountStorage', is a utility for persisting an account number in Android applications. It uses SharedPreferences for storage and provides thread-safe static methods for setting and retrieving the account number, with caching for performance.

classes.name: AccountStorage
classes.description: A utility class for storing and retrieving an account number in an Android application using SharedPreferences, thread-safe, with in-memory caching.

methods.name: SetAccount
methods.description: Sets the account number in SharedPreferences and updates the in-memory cache. Thread-safe, synchronized on sAccountLock.

methods.name: GetAccount
methods.description: Retrieves the account number from cache if available; otherwise reads from SharedPreferences and caches it. Thread-safe, synchronized on sAccountLock.
